name: cmi-evidence-surface
scope: Public evidence-bearing read models and human evidence-address rendering shared by Session, Handoff, Closing Intelligence, CLI, MCP structured content, and MCP resources.

compatibilityPolicy.breakingChanges: Removing or renaming a required field, changing its type or evidence meaning, weakening provenance, or changing the stable human evidence labels requires a new contract version and retained regression coverage for the prior contract.
compatibilityPolicy.runtimeVersionIndependence: The evidence contract version is independent from the CMI package/runtime version. A runtime release does not imply a contract-version bump.
compatibilityPolicy.legacy: Historical durable records that predate this contract fixture remain governed by their explicit compatibility exceptions and must not be rewritten merely to add contract metadata.

semanticInvariants: Finding ID is the durable identity and must remain the same across surfaces.
Evidence type and confidence must not be silently upgraded by formatting or transport.
Related files are evidence addresses, not proof of a violation.
Absent change/file/source evidence must remain absent rather than being synthesized.
A recommendation linked to a Finding must retain that Finding ID.
Evidence provenance and confidence must survive transport unchanged.
verificationState preserves suspected, observed, and established distinctions.
violationEstablished is true only when the verification semantics establish the violation.
Evidence anchors explain location/provenance and never promote relevance into truth.
Historical-project and current-session scope relations remain distinguishable.

humanEvidenceAddress.policy: Labels are part of the v1 human compatibility surface when the corresponding evidence exists. Optional address lines must not be invented when the underlying evidence is absent.
